Candidate A is more useful because it accurately captures the user's profile, budget, and contact preferences, whereas Candidate B ignores the budget update and asks for redundant contact info (email).
Candidate A is much more coherent, natural, and markdown-free. Candidate B uses markdown lists and fails to flow logically after the user provides their phone number.
